profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Pan-American Life Insurance Group
profile.summary:
Programmer/Analyst with over 20 years of successful development of business solutions for the IBM AS400/iSeries platform. Extensive knowledge of the health, property and casualty and liability insurance lines of business. Broad development experience in all segments of business management including claims adjudication, premium billing, commission and underwriting.

Specialties: AS400/iSeries COBOL, ILE, CL, SQL
Systems Implementation and Maintenance
Standards and Procedures
Planning and Development		
Design Specifications and Documentation
Audit and Financial Reporting
Agile/Scrum

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Creation and maintenance programming for in-house claims administration and premium billing production systems for the iSeries using COBOL, SQL and CL.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst & Tech Lead
positions.description:
Creation and maintenance programming for in-house production systems (payroll, group health, tax, etc.) for the iSeries using COBOL, SQL and CL. 

Technical lead for programming projects, specifications and staff management.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Maintenance programming for the client’s version of WINS 4.15 Claims Management and Administration vendor software and in-house ancillary systems for the iSeries using COBOL, SQL and CL. 

Creation of guidelines for task promotion by Aldon Lifecycle Manager for System i for software developers and operations staff.

positions.title: Contractor (for LeasePlan, Corp.)
positions.description:
Modify and create iSeries ILE COBOL and CL programs for access to JDE Oracle database files. 

Creation of trigger programs to update a client and its co-lessees Master Lease Agreement data within the JDE Oracle database files after web service calls to the iSeries.

Enhancement of test processes for iSeries web service calls to include a test scenario database, batch testing capability and reporting with throughput analysis.

positions.title: Contractor (for Blue Cross/Blue Shield of NC)
positions.description:
Modified iSeries ILE COBOL programs to accommodate Affordable Care Act (ACA) mandates for batch auto renewal of group policyholders. 

Enhancement of group policyholder batch premium billing processing to accommodate member level billing for small groups (51 or less) by inclusion of new ILE SQL Cobol programs, materialized query tables, ILE CL programs and QM queries.  

Technical analyst for level of effort (LOE) estimates on various projects including premium billing, invoice generation and over 65 (Medicare, etc).

positions.title: Independent Contractor for United States Achievement Academy
positions.description: Designed and produced the ILE COBOL and CL programs and reporting to automate the process of entering the Formsite nomination data of teacher nominations entries into the iSeries production database from IFS extract files, thereby alleviating 85% of previously needed manual labor.

positions.title: Contractor (for United States Achievement Academy in Lexington, KY)
positions.description:
Total rewrite of the student nomination email production system for the iSeries in ILE SQL Cobol and CL in order to automate time-consuming and error-prone manual processing and to produce mass teacher email address extract files.

Total rewrite of the invoicing and inventory system from RPG to ILE SQL Cobol and CL with reports for inventory listing, inventory reorder and sold listings and sales summary with sales tax and S/H charge by date range.    

Modified multiple data entry and maintenance programs for enhancements or errors in processing and rewrote several when program modification was no longer practical.  

Performed system administrator tasks to create specialized production menus for users, grant access to iSeries IFS folders, established the test environment for data, source and objects, create scheduled jobs for batch production, removed and reestablished journals and deleted obsolete files and libraries to conserve and recover DASD from 90% to 48%.

positions.title: Contractor (for Forcht Group in Lexington, KY)
positions.description:
Utilization of QM queries, ILE CL and SQL COBOL programs for reporting policy tax location codes based on an ISO provided database. 

Created batch FTP processing to send AR detail, policy draft payable and agent data to various server folders in text and Excel formats.  

Ran batch processing, resolved multiple abend issues and streamlined various processes to speed completion time and reduce paper waste.

Reestablished dormant processing for distribution and receipt of homeowner surveys for P&C policy renewal underwriting. 

Created various ongoing, ad-hoc and one-time reports and transfer files using queries and COBOL for policy tax, policy listings, special endorsements, etc. to satisfy regulatory reporting.

positions.title: Contractor (for Blue Cross/Blue Shield of NC)
positions.description:
Coding, test and implementation of ILE COBOL programs on the AS/400 for table maintenance of dependent and student age validation ranges. 

Creation of technical specifications for the payment processing of a new company for custom ancillary and vendor based PowerMHS processes.

positions.title: Contractor (for Blue Cross/Blue Shield of NC)
positions.description:
Coding, test and implementation of ILE COBOL programs on the AS/400 for table maintenance of dependent and student age validation ranges. 

Creation of technical specifications for the payment processing of a new company for custom ancillary and vendor based PowerMHS processes.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Maintenance programming of customized IBM AS/400 COBOL WINS software system for property and casualty insurance administration.

Design through production implementation of COBOL and CL programs for interface projects for the ImageRight document management system.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Design, code, test, document and maintain IBM AS/400 based ancillary support systems for the CSC POINT 9.0 software using OPM, ILE and SQL COBOL, CL, Query Manager and QUERY.

Analysis of user needs and creation of business specifications used to translate user requirements into software support systems.  

Definition of documentation standards and repository, investigation and implementation of new programming and testing utilities for the AS/400 and analysis and re-engineering of existing software for efficiency and throughput gains.

positions.title: Contractor (for Blue Cross/Blue Shield of NC)
positions.description:
Coding, test and implementation of COBOL programs on the AS/400 for the creation of extract files containing eligibility additions and changes from a PowerMHS database for export to a new external commission system. 

Produced detail specifications for modification of custom in-house programs for ancillary applications based on PowerMHS processes.  

Created and modified numerous QM queries for the audit and financial reporting of commission error transactions for the reconciliation and transition team.

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description:
Lead architect in planning and development with management staff for major projects on the AS400/iSeries.

Defined programming standards including creation of model system specifications, documentation and programs.

Provided support for technical production problems.

Mentored IT staff on problem resolution and provide on-call support. 

Evaluated application of new technology, including vendor packages.
 
Design, code, test and implementation of interface systems, maintenance and new systems for integration with Genelco Health Benefit Management System (HBMS) known as Group + using COBOL, SQL, QUERY and Command Language (CL) for the AS/400.
